subject: Devil Kazuya
object: Beat all 8 stages in Galaga using one continue or less
text: To play as Devil Kazuya you must first beat all 8 stages in Galaga using one continue or less and without using the dual ship code.

evidence.quote:
To play as Devil Kazuya you must first beat
     all 8 stages in Galaga using one continue or less and without using the
     dual ship code.

subject: Devil Kazuya
